parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the BioWin webserver

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: Port of the BioWin webserver. Defaults to 80.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Username for authenticating to the BioWin webserver

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Password for authenticating to the BioWin webserver

channel-type.label: BioWin Value
channel-type.description: Reads an integer or decimal value from the BioWin webserver using an OID like 0/802/435/heat.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often this value is refreshed from the BioWin webserver.
